create_InterpolationBlock: create an InterpolationBlock module to upsample or downsample 1D tensor sequences by a scale factor
build_interpolation_upsample: build an InterpolationBlock with scale_factor greater than 1 to upsample input tensors using nearest or linear interpolation
build_interpolation_downsample: build an InterpolationBlock with downsample=True to downsample input tensors by dividing the sequence length
test_InterpolationBlock_forward: test the InterpolationBlock forward method to verify it correctly resizes 1D tensors along the last dimension
review_InterpolationBlock: review the InterpolationBlock class and its forward method that wraps torch.nn.functional.interpolate for sequence interpolation
